pixel_equality_scope: Entire re-read PNG byte streams identical, independently guaranteeing identical decoded image content; recorded dimensions checked against PNG IHDR. No independent pixel decoder is required.
scope: Independent raw unique marker-enclosing renderer spans and raw process/event fields; all 19 point metrics, all six pairings, 10k shared whole-block primary CPU intervals. Exact frozen source/input/font/executable bytes checked. All accepted timings retained; query-only whole-block retries revalidated. Actual-font blobs checked only in separate untimed pixel launches, not timed glyph routing. RSS is process-lifetime OS high-water resident memory, not outline-only storage or GPU VRAM. No timing/build/application execution or runner/analyzer imports.
limitations: Non-primary confidence intervals, including RSS CIs, checked for JSON/CSV consistency but not independently recomputed.

Current mutable application checkout not rehashed while independent portable builds may temporarily swap manifests/locks; recorded build tracked-input guards, restored-lock flags and exact frozen FemtoVG snapshots were checked.
The encoded PNG bytes are independently compared; reported decoded-RGBA digests checked for consistency rather than independently decoded.
